milestone: M5.1 shared field rules and automatic validation

commands.note: Only the latest sixteen gates certify the frozen map. Preserve development failures and source-change observations separately; historical runtime is not recertified.

checks.example_types: pass; existing Node Vite config/mock server excluded
checks.installed_shared_rules: The same tar proves Form/Grid/List typed formatting/validation, valid unused declarations, automatic bypass, complete explicit checks and atomic paste, parse preservation and exact quiet disposal.

blocks.merge: Adjacent scalar group keys span complete two-row records; each native merge stays inside a consecutive mounted segment.

method.timing: Rows and authored HTML prepared outside timing. Each operation includes two successive stable animation-frame geometry observations; fail after fifteen frames.
method.focus: One invalid draft editor remains pinned with its exact node and caret while a distant variable-height window renders.
method.paste: Flat/nested paste one thousand offscreen records; blocks paste one hundred. Each changes two fields in one atomic event; nested detail uses numeric Select values.
method.move: Move the last of five thousand stored rows before a stable row near the current window; one event, unchanged snapshot and pinned draft/caret. Includes settled DOM with a 100ms same-host Chromium median budget.

append.operation: After original operations and twenty scroll-cycle assertions, append 250 clean records in one event. Preserve every old snapshot/order, save changes, checks, focused node/draft/caret and scroll anchor. Dispose all 5,250 records under the original cleanup budget.

method.geometry: Every live checkpoint requires intersecting mounted data rows and different measured row heights; reveal verifies the complete requested record rectangle and forward scroll advances logical intersection. Blocks record native physical-row heights, record bounds and merge spans; twenty cycle windows record actual intersections.
method.cleanup: Exact authored markup/style after disposal, then observe zero mutations across late scroll and stable frames; this observes quiet work, not a direct cancelAnimationFrame call.
method.memory: Chromium CDP forces GC before DOM counters; twenty-cycle growth remains bounded by two viewport element counts and twenty listeners. After detaching the fixture, record native focus/selection retention, release it by focusing the existing external main and clearing document ranges, wait two frames, then require the stated pre-fixture cleanup budget. No JavaScript heap-retention claim.
method.budgets: Host-relative Chromium medians declared before measurement; other engines report samples without applying Chromium thresholds.

performance.limits: Unchanged same-host Chromium fixtures, warmups, samples and nine binding/twenty-one viewport budgets. Rule compilation occurs per binder; no universal speed or actual-token claim.

review.baseline: Independent a0f837a recovery matches177 inputs,50rawlogs,12manifests,16latest final gates and every actual183-file package member; historical runtime was not rerun.
review.source: Independent connected Ponytail source/caller/example/consumer review; effective rule guards, automatic/full reconciliation, native integrity and existing Form scalar-choice boundary checked.
review.evidence: Independent raw review matches26 logs/3 manifests/current179 inputs, all actual183 archive payloads and individual sizes, all60 medians from300 durations,105live checkpoints/300scroll windows/15append+quiet disposals,1595block geometries/265merge spans, and all original budgets.
review.scope: One FieldRules type and existing RuleSet.fields/Form/Grid autoValidate options; no new framework module, entry, handle, registry, dependency or utility package.

limits: Only selected shared field rules, effective guards, automatic policy and application rule composition are accepted. Form raw choice/render mapping, List editing, Tree validation, bind-value/global callback/default lifecycles, legacy unvalidated paste, wire/CVC/parity/P0 and mandatory M13 remain required.
Actual macOS/iOS Safari is excluded. Manual assistive technology and final fixed-agent/token evaluation remain unverified. No npm publication, release tag, master/v1 change or omission.

The initial WebKit date-sanitization witness assumed native date support; the corrected test checks its effective date/text type and keeps range integrity mandatory. The failed development log remains preserved.
